points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段时间短且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，仍平是基础高概率分支。
points.rationale_en: Because extra time is short and knockout risk appetite usually falls, a further draw remains the baseline high-probability branch.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
points.rationale_cn: England凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
points.rationale_en: England can win extra time by one goal through fatigue edge, bench impact, or counterattack efficiency.

points.tail_title_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜

points.tail_title_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
points.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
points.tail_title_en: Open extra time / both teams score
points.rationale_en: Extra time opens up enough for both sides to convert one meaningful chance.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: England在对手压上后连续制造转换机会。
points.rationale_en: England can create repeated transition chances if Norway pushes too high.

points.tail_title_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
points.rationale_cn: Norway在对手体能或心理崩盘后拉开比分。
points.rationale_en: Norway can stretch the score if England suffers a fatigue or psychological drop-off.

tail_focus.label: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时偷袭 / 一球决胜
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时30分钟内通过反击、定位球或替补冲击形成1球胜负。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: England凭借体能、替补或反击效率在加时净胜一球。
tail_focus.definition_en: A one-goal margin in extra time created through counters, set pieces, or substitute impact.
tail_focus.rationale_en: England can win extra time by one goal through fatigue edge, bench impact, or counterattack efficiency.

tail_focus.label: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.label_cn: 加时开放 / 双方进球
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时阶段双方均有进球，比赛从谨慎拖入开放对攻。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: 加时阶段比赛打开，双方各有一次有效转化。
tail_focus.label_en: Open extra time / both teams score
tail_focus.definition_en: Both teams score in extra time as the match shifts from caution into a more open exchange.
tail_focus.rationale_en: Extra time opens up enough for both sides to convert one meaningful chance.

tail_focus.label: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.label_cn: 体能崩盘 / 加时打穿
tail_focus.definition_cn: 加时净胜至少2球，或总进球达到3球以上的一方打穿路径。
tail_focus.rationale_cn: England在对手压上后连续制造转换机会。
tail_focus.definition_en: A side wins extra time by at least two goals, or the extra-time segment reaches three or more total goals.
tail_focus.rationale_en: England can create repeated transition chances if Norway pushes too high.

key_factors.impact_en: Extra time is not modeled as an independent match; it is the conditional branch after a draw in 90 minutes.
